messages.subject: Project Solstice - SSA v3
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Our v3 attached. We've accepted your changes to the founder cap (1x), the thresholds (£20k / £100k) and the 24-month period. Two points from our side:
- the borrowing consent threshold raised from £250k to £500k (the business will need headroom post-raise);
- a small good-leaver clarification so that a founder dismissed other than for cause is a good leaver.
Hopefully these are uncontroversial and we can move to execution.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1190
